body:
I put 25 mg on a bowl of mugwort. Started with small hits and felt a strange almost dissociated feeling with a jittery bit. On my second hit, almost felt like a ketamine mixed with a DMT feel. Very intense.
My friend took a big hit and apparently it was a smidge too much. She started screaming a bit and having a small seizure. My group stopped using right after. The OD line is very fine. Be careful.
